Isolation

Winter hike to a secluded White Mountain 4000-footer

  • Written: Jan 23, 2015
  • Date hiked: Jan 23, 2015
  • Peak: Isolation (4,003 feet)
  • Distance: 14 miles
  • Town: Livermore
  • State: New Hampshire

Isolation lives up to its name—a quieter 4000-footer off the beaten Presidential traverse paths. January snow, long miles, and views that feel earned because so few people make the full loop out here.
